profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Relevant Radio | Amateur Economist | Thinker
profile.summary:
I was formerly a passionless aerospace engineer, but then I found coding. All of the sudden, I found something I could get behind; something that I wanted to be great at and be a leader at. "Why didn't I study computer science in college?" I have found myself wondering.

Thankfully, coding bootcamps like Tech Elevator exist and I took the plunge. I learned the basics of Object Oriented Programming in Java, Git, Unit Testing (JUnit), IntelliJ, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, VS Code, Spring Boot, JSON, and Responsive Design. In my current role at Comcast I am using many of these skills on technician scheduling software and learned new skills like Scala, Akka, mongoDB, and more.

I bring a keen eye for detail, strong communication skills, while focusing on the big picture. Having to ensure structural integrity of aircraft, high integrity is a strong value of mine.

With my background and skills, I am confident I can be the software developer that your organization is looking for. Feel free to connect with me or send me a message.

positions.description: Improving the FREE Relevant Radio app through native mobile software development on Android and iPhone.

positions.title: Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
Completed a Java bootcamp at Tech Elevator. Below is a list of projects I completed during my time there:

1. Virtual Vending Machine
- Planned, developed, and tested with a team of 3 a virtual vending machine that allows users to view items, quantities, and prices in a hypothetical vending machine. Object-oriented programming fundamentals in Java were employed in this pair-programming exercise.

2. TEnmo Money Transfer App
- Completed a money transfer command line interface app as part of Tech Elevator curriculum. This client-server project was planned, developed, and tested in a pair-programming environment. Object-oriented programming with Java, SQL call statements, and Spring database interaction were all used to complete this project.

3. YEGET Flashcard Study App
- Collaborated with a team of 5 on creating a flashcard study website that utilized full-stack software development. Back-end server was a RESTful API completed using object-oriented programming in Java, Spring database interaction, and PostgreSQL. The front-end was completed using Vue.js.
positions.insights: Skills: Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) · IntelliJ IDEA · Vue.js · Spring Framework · SQL · Unit Testing (JUnit) · Spring MVC · PostgreSQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Java · Git · Spring Boot · HTML

positions.title: H-47 Chinook Structural Analysis Engineer
positions.description:
- Ensured safe integration of new radar pod to the G Block II Chinook helicopter
- Analyzed flight test data from strain gauges on the new radar pod
- Monitored flight test in Mesa, AZ of the new F Block II chinook helicopter
- Ensured safety of structure throughout the monitoring of F Block II flight test

positions.title: MQ-25 Structural Analysis Engineer
positions.description:
- Communicated with a team of 7 to ensure coordination and schedule compliance
- Analyzed parts of aircraft systems for structural integrity

positions.title: F/A-18 Structural Analysis Engineer
positions.description:
- Analyzed fixes to extensive repairs to be completed at Naval Air Station Cecil Field
- Incorporated extra durability into repairs to match Block III improvements to F/A-18
- Used Boeing internal analysis tool CAESAR to analyze fastener holes

positions.title: 777X MTE Structural Analysis Engineer
positions.locationName: Ridley Park, Pennsylvania, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Computed fastener bending fatigue margins of safety in the aft spar extension region
- Analyzed MRB tag non-conformances and validated structural integrity of disposition
- Reevaluated 9 MRB tags using CASTLE for structural integrity due to loads change
- Evaluating damage limits on aileron closure rib flanges, webs, and stiffeners

positions.title: Structural Analysis Engineer
positions.description: I was a structural analysis engineer working on vehicle level finite element models for the 737 MAX. My team and I worked to determine the loads on the internal structure of the aircraft through running of the finite element models. This data was sent on to structural analysis engineers working with the designers to design safe parts.

positions.title: Structural Analysis/Design Intern on 737MAX
positions.description: I worked as an intern on the structural analysis and design teams for the winglets of the 737 MAX. I was able to split my time between being a designer and a structural analyst. I developed some skills using CATIA while being a designer and PATRAN while being a structural analyst. I was able to design a modified mount for the winglet that was used for mockup purposes.

positions.title: Thermal Systems Design Co-op
positions.description: Worked in thermal systems design section in engineering at GE Aviation. Provided heat transfer and secondary flows analysis on GE9X engine. Developed skills in the program PATRAN.

positions.title: CFM56/CF6 Assembly Co-op
positions.description: Worked as a co-op in CFM56 and CF6 assembly at GE Aviation in Evendale, Ohio. Worked on projects to improve efficiency and quality efforts of the assembly line.
